reason: A research-paper study toolkit that parses PDFs, generates summaries and adaptive learning materials, extracts figures and code links, and provides a local searchable web viewer across supported agent hosts.

summaries.zh: 用于解析研究论文并生成摘要、学习材料、问答和代码演示，同时通过本地网页界面管理和检索论文内容。
summaries.en: A research-paper learning toolkit that parses PDFs, generates summaries and study materials, extracts relevant content, and provides a local searchable web viewer.

capabilities: Parse local or remote PDF research papers
Extract paper text, metadata, links, figures, and images
Generate summaries, study materials, questions, and code demonstrations
Write processed materials to a local paper library
Launch a local web viewer for browsing and searching processed papers
Install or update agent adapters and plugin files
